reason: Removed from the live dataset at owner request (round 5, decision 2, 2026-10-11): consumer records (Sonos, Bose, Sony, Boston Acoustics) whose manufacturer publishes no acoustic specification (structural facts only, overallStatus UNVERIFIED), and the generic Electro-Voice Zx3 record, replaced by exact variants Zx3-60 and Zx3-90 (decision 1). Full records are archived unchanged; they are not speaker data.

records.notes: Pass-128 check (2026-10-10): Exact-model manufacturer page not located. Retailer, blog and forum copies conflict between the vintage A150 and the A150 Series 2 / current A150; none transferred. Pass-130 check (2026-10-10): only forum, resale and retailer listings were found, and they conflict (36–25 kHz ±3 dB vs 38 Hz–20 kHz; ~90 dB; 15–150 W vs 100 W). No Boston Acoustics manufacturer source was found. Pass-136 check (2026-10-10): Secondary sources describe the A150 as produced in Series I, II and III. Copies conflict on the low-frequency limit (36 Hz vs 38 Hz), the sensitivity (about 90 dB) and the power rating (15–150 W vs 100 W). No Boston Acoustics manufacturer source is available for any series, so the revision is unresolved and no values are stored. Pass-138 check (2026-10-10): Secondary copies differ by series. A 1970s-era A150 description (stereonomono.blogspot.com, 2020) gives 36 Hz-25 kHz +/-3 dB, 90 dB at 1 W/1 m, 8 ohm, 550 Hz and 3 kHz crossovers, three-way with a 10 in woofer; a Series 2 forum copy gives 36-25 kHz and 100 W. These are not merged with the bare A150 record, which does not state a series.

A later Bose story says “dual transducers handle mids and highs,” but does not state that two is the total; the exact launch release is the source for the explicit total. No response bounds, driver dimensions, or directivity are inferred. Source: https://www.bose.com/pressroom/bose-soundlink-max; secondary wording checked: https://www.bose.com/stories/bose-soundlink-max-ultimate-party-speaker. These conflict and no Bose page was reached, so the driver count is not stored. One review states that Bose does not publish a power or frequency-response figure. Pass-137 driver-count check (2026-10-10): Bose press release (manufacturer): three transducers across the front (Bose Articulated Array) and two passive radiators; this matches driverCount 3 (active transducers). Secondary specs (TechRadar, Sound Advice) give 2×89 mm, 1×23 mm and two 104×79 mm radiators, consistent with the count. No frequency, sensitivity or impedance is published, so no field is stored.

Matches driverCount 9. Not Bose manufacturer text; no frequency or sensitivity is stored.

Round 3 variant decision: this generic record does not identify the horn/variant suffix (the source manual covers several variants and PI versions). Sensitivity, impedance, power, woofer size and frequency response are therefore UNAVAILABLE until the exact variant is identified; the series-level values from the source are retained in the notes below and are not verified for this record. driverCount (2) and active (false, passive) remain as sourced. Electro-Voice Zx3 Owner's Manual, manufacturer document (hosted copy: https://www.eviaudio.fr/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/ev_zx3_manuel.pdf). Its specification table gives 58 Hz–15 kHz (-3 dB), 48 Hz–20 kHz (-10 dB), 97 dB axial sensitivity at 1 W/1 m, 600 W continuous / 2400 W peak passive handling, 8 Ω nominal (6.2 Ω minimum), one 12-inch DVX3121 LF transducer plus one ND2 HF compression driver, passive/biamp-selectable operation, 131 dB calculated maximum SPL, and a 50 Hz recommended high-pass. The response/sensitivity footnote says half-space measurement. This manual identifies ZX3-60, ZX3-90, PI and finish variants; these structured fields are shared in its series-level specification table. Its numeric response and directivity tables are separately identified for ZX3-60 and ZX3-90, so no variant-specific curve or directivity payload is assigned to the generic ZX3 record. Round 4 suffix check: the generic ZX3 record has no SKU and cannot be matched. Two exact variants exist with different horn coverage: ZX3-60W (SKU EV-F.01U.265.586, 60 x 60 horn; empirepro.com/electro-voice-zx3-60w/) and ZX3-90W (SKU EV-F.01U.265.584, 90 x 50 horn; empirepro.com/products/electro-voice-zx3-90w). Neither is assigned to this record; sensitivity, impedance, power, woofer and frequency response remain UNAVAILABLE.
